ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white pixels occupy approximately 85-90% of the fluke surface area, contrasted against low-intensity black perimeter pixels and central spots.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous white central region. Low-intensity black border along the entire trailing edge. Vertical sequence of discrete dark pixel clusters (mottling) located along the central axis starting from the peduncle base. One isolated dark circular spot located on the upper-mid region of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an estimated interior angle of 45-55 degrees; vertex depth is approximately 10% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Low-frequency, irregular serrations along the trailing edge. Pixel amplitude of peaks varies from 2-8 pixels. Highest density of irregular jaggedness is located at the distal lobe tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical, primarily linear sweep with a subtle posterior convexity transitioning into rounded distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Vertical alignment of three distinct, high-contrast dark pixel clusters near the central midline of the fluke.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized dark pigmentation or potential scarring at the junction where the peduncle meets the fluke lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique isolated dark spot on the interior of the left lobe, approximately one-third of the distance from the median notch to the tip.
